## SparrowDesk Phone Calls

Launching today

Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.
